[RDSC.14.3.4] Each Rete node the compiler attributes to a
source construct carries one `LineSpan` atom keyed by its
`node_id`. `node_id`s are bundle-global and unique, so `LineSpan`
atoms cannot collide; a `LineSpan` atom whose `node_id` does not
correspond to an emitted `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode` or `TerminalNode` atom is a
malformed file. The owning module is recovered from the
`LineSpan` atom's `module_id`.
